records.title: Learning to Deliberate: Multi-pass Decoding for Document-Grounded Conversations
records.reason: IEEE DOI/publisher full text was inaccessible. The abstract proposes multi-pass decoding and global context updates for document-grounded conversation, but no direct compute/latency/memory improvement is established; primary method/evaluation and whether the added passes increase cost could not be checked.

records.title: Non-Autoregressive Sign Language Translation: A Transformer Encoder-only Approach for Enhanced Multimodal Integration
records.reason: ACM DOI full text was inaccessible and search returned bibliographic records. Abstract proposes encoder-only non-autoregressive sign-language translation to avoid one-by-one token generation, but application-specific evidence and actual latency/quality tradeoffs remain unverified.

records.title: Direct-Inverse Prompting: Analyzing LLMs' Discriminative Capacity in Self-Improving Generation
records.reason: Primary arXiv full text at https://arxiv.org/html/2407.11017 studies direct/inverse prompting to improve answer selection and generation accuracy on MATH and related tasks; it does not reduce inference compute, memory, latency, throughput, or serving cost.

records.title: iMotion-LLM: Instruction-Conditioned Trajectory Generation
records.reason: Primary arXiv full text at https://arxiv.org/html/2406.06211 presents an LLM for instruction-conditioned driving trajectories. It explicitly notes LLM-based models incur higher inference costs and are currently more suited to offline use; the contribution is motion generation/safety, not efficiency improvement.

records.title: A Low-Latency and Scalable Vector Engine with Operation Fusion for Transformers
records.reason: IEEE Xplore primary full text could not be retrieved through the available reader; abstract/metadata describes a low-latency scalable vector engine that fuses Transformer LayerNorm/Softmax and element-wise operations. It is plausibly relevant to inference latency but primary benchmarks and limitations remain unavailable.
